gap: No result ChatGPT got states the EcoFlow RIVER 3's full solar window (11–30 V, 8 A, 110 W) with EcoFlow's panel-count rule (one panel in series; at most three 45 W or two 60 W in parallel), or that the BLUETTI Elite 30 mini ships with AC and car cables but no solar cable or panel.
standout_why: I compared the two cited pages (The Inertia, PowerSized Black Friday) and five other results (Watt & Warden, Radar of Products, MachineFanatic, The Power Station Guide, RV Gear Lab). The Inertia gives the RIVER 3's input only as 'DC/AC'. PowerSized gives the Elite 30 mini only as 288 Wh / 300 W / 7.3 lb at $199. The Power Station Guide already has the RIVER 3's 110 W solar cap, so the wattage is not new. None of the seven gives a voltage window, a series/parallel rule, a connector or box contents for any AC unit under $200. The score stays at 1 because I could not open a BLUETTI document today for the Elite 30 mini's own solar window, which would have made this a 2.
decides: It does not change the pick. It confirms the Elite 30 mini's row: the AC and car cables are in the box at $199. It also adds one caveat for both top candidates: solar is a single small-panel add-on that takes the purchase past $200. BLUETTI's own bundles are $319.99 with a 60 W panel and $389.99 with a 100 W panel. On the RIVER 3, EcoFlow rules out two of its 45 W or 60 W panels in series.

findings.label: Solar input window (maker's support FAQ)
findings.note: EcoFlow's wording: 'EcoFlow RIVER 3 solar input specifications: Voltage range 11~30V, maximum current 8A, maximum power 110W.' This is EcoFlow's Philippines-region support page; the US store returned 429/403 and ecoflow.com/us returned 404 today.

findings.label: How many EcoFlow panels it accepts (maker's rule)
findings.value: 45 W panels: 1 in series, up to 3 in parallel; 60 W panels: 1 in series, up to 2 in parallel
findings.note: EcoFlow adds: 'All three conditions must be met; exceeding any one of them means the solar panels cannot be used.' The three conditions are the volts, amps and watts above. Arithmetic: 3 × 45 W = 135 W and 2 × 60 W = 120 W of nameplate panel into a 110 W cap. The answer as read names only the 45 W and 60 W panels.

findings.label: Solar and wall charging together
findings.value: Supported; AC takes priority when both are connected, and the priority can be changed in the app
findings.note: FAQ 'Does EcoFlow RIVER 3 / RIVER 3 Plus support simultaneous solar and AC charging?': 'Yes, the charging priority can be adjusted in the app.' and 'When both AC and solar inputs are connected, AC charging will take priority.'

findings.label: Solar input window, for contrast with the RIVER 3 (generation limit)
findings.note: Same FAQ answer. The Plus takes more panels in series or parallel than the RIVER 3; a panel set sized for the Plus can exceed the RIVER 3's 30 V / 8 A / 110 W limits. The Plus is not a row on this page; I did not read its price.

findings.label: What is in the box
findings.value: Power station ×1, AC charging cable ×1, car charging cable ×1, user manual ×1 (no solar cable, no panel)

findings.note: From the 'In The Box' list on BLUETTI's US page. The same four items are listed on the +60 W and +100 W bundle pages, which do not name the panel model.
